Strategy: Score favors the bin whose residual is farthest from the mean residual, pushing choices toward either the tightest or the emptiest bin and avoiding the middle. It differs from Best Fit whenever the farthest bin is the emptiest one. It may help by consolidating packing into extremes and leaving clean mid-size bins, or fail by alternating wastefully between nearly full and nearly empty bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    m = sum(bins) / len(bins)
    return [abs(r - m) for r in bins]
```
